Exercise A

Listening: Volunteering Info Evening

You will hear each recording twice, just like in the real MSA exam. Listen carefully, then answer the questions below — you won't be able to play a recording more than twice.

💡 Exam tip: In the real exam you hear each recording exactly twice — use the first play to get the general gist, then the second to fill in exact details, rather than trying to catch everything at once.
Part 1 — Information Session
Part 1 — Comprehension Questions

1 How long do placements last?

2 What are the two main types of project?

3 What does the programme fee cover?

4 How much should students budget for flights?

5 When do applications close?

Part 2 — Dialogue: Two Students
Part 2 — Comprehension Questions

6 What is Isla worried about?

7 What could help with costs?

8 Which project does Isla want, and why?

Exercise B

Reading: Volunteer Projects & Info Notice

Read the texts below, then answer the questions — just like Reading Parts 1 and 2 in the real MSA exam.

Part 1 — Match the Student to the Project

Wildlife Conservation (Kenya): Help monitor and protect endangered animals in a national park.

Teaching English (Vietnam): Support local teachers in primary school English classes.

Turtle Conservation (Costa Rica): Protect sea turtle nests on the beach at night.

Community Building (Costa Rica): Help build a new community centre alongside local volunteers.

1 Grace loves animals and wants to work outdoors in nature. She should choose .

2 Liam wants to become a teacher and loves working with children. He should choose .

3 Priya is fascinated by the ocean and marine life. She should choose .

4 Ahmed enjoys practical, hands-on work like building things. He should choose .

Part 2 — Info Notice: True or False?

✈️ Flights are not included in the programme fee.

🍽️ Volunteers receive two meals a day as part of the fee.

📅 Applications open in January and close at the end of March.

⏳ The longest placement available is twelve weeks.

5 Flights are included in the programme fee.

6 Two meals a day are included.

7 Applications can be submitted at any time of year.

8 The longest placement is twelve weeks.

Exercise C

Writing: Blog Post

Choose ONE of the two prompts below and write 80–100 words, just like Writing Part 3 in the real MSA exam. This section is graded by your teacher, not automatically.

Choose ONE prompt

Prompt 1: Would you like to do a volunteering project abroad? Explain why or why not.

Prompt 2: Describe what you think makes a good volunteer.
